title: Needs and wants: sorting what we must have
examples: What is the difference between needs and wants?
Is a phone a need or a want?

groups.label: It depends
groups.ask: Can a want become a need?

explain.say: Imagine you only have a little money. Would you buy water or a new video game? Some things you need to live; others you just want. Look at the board: things sorted into needs, wants, and a tricky middle box.

draw.text: Needs and wants: sorting what we must have

groups.label: It depends
groups.ask: Can a want become a need?

explain.say: See the needs box? A need is something you must have to live and stay healthy: water, food, a home, clothes and health care. Every family in the world, from Lagos to Lima, needs these. Can you add one more need?

groups.label: It depends
groups.ask: Can a want become a need?

explain.say: Now the wants box. A want is something nice to have, but you can live without it, like sweets, toys or new trainers. Wants are fine! We just choose them after needs. What is something you really want right now?

groups.label: It depends
groups.ask: Can a want become a need?

explain.say: Look at the tricky box: it depends. A phone may be a want for you, but a need for a farmer in Kenya who gets paid through it. A bike may be a need if it is your only way to school. Can you think of another tricky one?

groups.label: It depends
groups.ask: Can a want become a need?

explain.say: So needs come first, then wants, and sometimes it depends on your life. Great sorting! Your challenge: tonight, look in your school bag and sort five things into needs and wants.

groups.label: It depends
groups.ask: Can a want become a need?

faq.a: A need is something you must have to live and stay healthy, like clean water, food, a home, clothes and health care.
A want is something you would like to have but can live without, like toys, sweets or the latest trainers.

faq.q: Can a want become a need?
faq.a: Yes, it depends on your life. A phone is a want for many children, but a need for someone whose work or money depends on it. A bike can be a need if it is the only way to school.
asks: Is a phone a need or a want?

faq.a: Because without needs like food and a home you cannot stay healthy or safe. Once needs are covered, money left over can go on wants.

faq.q: Is it wrong to have wants?
faq.a: Not at all! Wants make life fun. The trick is choosing which wants matter most, because money and time are limited.

facts: Article 25 of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights lists food, clothing, housing and medical care as part of a decent standard of living.
Kenya's M-Pesa mobile money service, launched in 2007, lets people send and receive money by phone.
